name: Camazotz, Demon Lord Of Bats And Fire

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.text: Camazotz can use his action to polymorph into a form that resembles a giant bat covered in smoldering ashes, or back into his true, winged humanoid form. His statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Either form turns into a pile of greasy ash if destroyed.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: Camazotz can't use his blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: Camazotz has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Gift of Vampirism
traits.text: Camazotz may choose to raise those slain through Strength loss as vampires. They rise after 1d4 days, permanently dominated by Camazotz until such time as he sees fit to grant them free will. Camazotz may have no more than ten enslaved vampires at any given time.

traits.name: Heat Mantle
traits.text: Camazotz is infused with the heart of volcanoes. A creature who strikes Camazotz with a nonreach weapon or with an unarmed strike takes 7 (2d6) fire damage automatically.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
Camazotz' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: darkness, detect evil and good, dispel magic, plane shift, shapechange, telekinesis, teleport

3/day each: banishment, haste, symbol

1/day: earthquake

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Camazotz has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Summon Bats (1/Day)
traits.text: Camazotz can summon 4d6 giant bats or 2d6 swarms of bats. The bats appear immediately and serve the demon for up to 1 hour.

traits.name: Summon Demons (1/Day)
traits.text: Camazotz can summon 2d4 barlgura of a variety native to his cavernous realm: squat and blubbery creatures with clawed batwings for arms and a fly speed of 40 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Camazotz makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (8d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must make a successful DC 22 Constitution saving throw or have its Strength score reduced by 1d4. A creature reduced to 0 Strength dies.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target must make a successful DC 22 Constitution saving throw or have its Strength score reduced by 1d4. A creature reduced to 0 Strength dies.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Camazotz can breathe a 30-foot cone of unholy fire. Any creature caught in the area takes 55 (10d10) damage, half of which is fire, the other half is necrotic, or half as much damage with a successful DC 22 Dexterity saving throw.
